Contoso Demo Tool Interface and Configuration

Resource Allocation and Technician Work Execution

features.name: Service Management Model in Contoso Demo Tool
features.description: The Contoso Coffee demo data tool now includes support for service management, offering demo data to demonstrate two different scenarios in the service area including ad hoc repairs and service contracts.

features.name: Simplified Configuration Pages in Contoso Demo Tool
features.description: The Contoso demo tool now has dramatically simpler configuration pages with shared details moved into a common model, removing duplicate pages and consolidating common settings like sales tax, company type, and currency details.

features.name: Demo Data Generation Modes
features.description: The Contoso demo tool supports two generation modes: generate full setup and demo data including master data and transactions, or generate setup data only with number series and various setups without master data.

features.name: Ad Hoc Service Order with Item Replacement
features.description: Demonstration of handling ad hoc service orders where customers report issues with items not originally sold as service items, with support for troubleshooting, fault resolution codes, and replacement item management.
caveats: Items used may not be originally created as service items

features.name: Troubleshooting and Fault Resolution Code Search
features.description: Service management includes quick troubleshooting functionality and advanced fault resolution code search to identify symptoms and recommended resolutions for service issues.

features.name: Service Technician Task List and Item Worksheet
features.description: Service technicians can access a task list of scheduled service orders and use an item worksheet to view details about items being fixed, symptoms, and recommended resolutions.

features.name: Service Hours Registration
features.description: Service technicians can register work hours spent on service tasks with support for updating status to finished when work is complete.

features.name: Service Order Posting - Ship and Invoice
features.description: Service managers can post completed service orders with options to ship and invoice in a single action.
features.status_evidence_quote: they see the finished service order, what they can just do, go and post it. Post, ship, and invoice.

features.name: Automatic Service Item Creation from Sales Orders
features.description: Service items are automatically created when a sales order is posted, enabling subsequent service contract management for those items.

features.name: Service Contract Templates
features.description: Service contracts can be created from templates that demonstrate different patterns, including prepayment contracts with monthly repair orders.

features.name: Service Order Types for Contract Classification
features.description: Service order types can be used to define different contract types such as maintenance, making it easier to monitor and manage service contracts.

features.name: Service Contract Signing and Invoicing
features.description: Service contracts can be signed and generate service invoices for prepayment and monthly charges, with support for charging remainder of month upon contract signing.

features.name: Create Service Orders from Service Contracts
features.description: Service orders can be automatically created from service contracts for valid periods, such as monthly maintenance orders generated from maintenance contracts.

features.name: Dispatch Board and Resource Allocation
features.description: The dispatch board provides resource allocation functionality to assign service orders to resources with time allocation, and supports filtering by zones or skills.

features.name: Service Task Execution with Hours Registration
features.description: Service technicians can execute service tasks by registering actual hours worked, which may differ from planned allocation, and mark tasks as finished.

features.name: Service Order Line Quantity to Consume
features.description: Service order lines support changing quantity settings from quantity to invoice to quantity to consume, enabling internal consumption tracking separate from invoicing processes.

features.name: Extensibility of Contoso Demo Tool
features.description: The Contoso demo tool is highly extensible, allowing partners to add vertical functionality and reuse existing models.
